title: Eric Wang's secret UFO work at Kirtland, per his wife
place_text: Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Bill Steinman gets in touch with his wife uh Maria Wing and she says, "Oh yeah, he worked at Kirtland Air Force Base. He worked on some, you know, secret UFO related stuff."

plain: A man named Eric Henry Wang did secret UFO work at Kirtland Air Force Base in New Mexico in the 1950s and 1960s, according to his wife, Maria Wang. Jesse Michels tells how a researcher named Bill Steinman reached her, and she told him that her husband had worked there on "secret UFO related stuff." If true, it would place Wang inside a hidden government UFO effort.
